stories.prompt: Add a request-scoped run-once guard to RouteCapabilityMiddleware so the same request traversing the middleware twice evaluates the resolver and authorization exactly once. Single execution remains unchanged. Do not touch the benchmark test file.
acceptanceCriteria: The same request traversing RouteCapabilityMiddleware twice invokes RouteRequirementResolver exactly once and evaluates Gate authorization exactly once.
Only the frozen middleware production file and unit-test path may change.
atddConstraints: The correct nested double-traversal test must declare shouldReceive('resolve')->once(); a twice() resolver expectation contradicts the frozen product contract.
The nested next handler is invoked twice, while Gate::forUser() and Gate::allows() are each invoked exactly once.
The editable Unit test must use the exact method identity same_request_is_evaluated_only_once_when_middleware_runs_twice so discovery is frozen before green.

controlledPostRedCorrection.initialAtddDefect: Create the initial editable test with exactly these four call counts and no other semantic defect: RouteRequirementResolver::resolve('invoices.index') twice(), nested $next twice(), Gate::forUser($user) once() returning Gate, and Gate::allows('invoices.view') once() returning true. Bind the genuine initial red caused by the once-only Gate expectations while preserving only the deliberate resolver twice() contradiction.
controlledPostRedCorrection.developerFinding: Only RouteRequirementResolver::resolve()->twice() contradicts the acceptance criterion. Confirm $next->twice(), Gate::forUser()->once(), and Gate::allows()->once() are already correct, then detect the resolver contradiction before any mutation and request the typed post-red correction.
controlledPostRedCorrection.replacementExpectation: Change only RouteRequirementResolver::resolve()->twice() to once(). Preserve $next->twice(), Gate::forUser()->once(), Gate::allows()->once(), the test identity, and all other bytes before binding the replacement behavioral red.
